info.name: Chanor Supervisor API
info.description: API documentation for Chanor Supervisor (Admin) endpoints. These endpoints provide administrative dashboard access, analytics, customer management, transaction monitoring, and system settlement information. **Authentication:** Supervisor endpoints require `x-apikey` header and Clerk Authentication. Dev tools endpoints are API-key only and are disabled in production.
